record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> of mercy<WH02617> and judgment<WH04941>: unto thee, O LORD<WH03068>, will I sing<WH02167><WTH8762>.

I will behave myself wisely<WH07919><WTH8686> in a perfect<WH08549> way<WH01870>. O when wilt thou come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto me? I will walk<WH01980><WTH8691> within<WH07130> my house<WH01004> with a perfect<WH08537> heart<WH03824>.

I will set<WH07896><WTH8799> no wicked<WH01100> thing<WH01697> before mine eyes<WH05869>: I hate<WH08130><WTH8804> the work<WH06213><WTH8800> of them that turn aside<WH07750>; <FI>it<Fi> shall not cleave<WH01692><WTH8799> to me. <RF>wicked...: Heb. thing of Belial<Rf>
A froward<WH06141> heart<WH03824> shall depart<WH05493><WTH8799> from me: I will not know<WH03045><WTH8799> a wicked<WH07451> <FI>person<Fi> .

Whoso privily<WH05643> slandereth<WH03960><WTH8764><WTH8675><WH03960><WTH8781> his neighbour<WH07453>, him will I cut off<WH06789><WTH8686>: him that hath an high<WH01362> look<WH05869> and a proud<WH07342> heart<WH03824> will not I suffer<WH03201><WTH8799>.

Mine eyes<WH05869> <FI>shall be<Fi> upon the faithful<WH0539><WTH8737> of the land<WH0776>, that they may dwell<WH03427><WTH8800> with me: he that walketh<WH01980><WTH8802> in a perfect<WH08549> way<WH01870>, he shall serve<WH08334><WTH8762> me. <RF>in a...: or, perfect in the way<Rf>

He that worketh<WH06213><WTH8802> deceit<WH07423> shall not dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> within<WH07130> my house<WH01004>: he that telleth<WH01696><WTH8802> lies<WH08267> shall not tarry<WH03559><WTH8735> in my sight<WH05869>. <RF>shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established<Rf>

I will early<WH01242> destroy<WH06789><WTH8686> all the wicked<WH07563> of the land<WH0776>; that I may cut off<WH03772><WTH8687> all wicked<WH0205> doers<WH06466><WTH8802> from the city<WH05892> of the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
